programme.title: Spiritual Explorers
programme.desc: Our explorer gains an insight into"iki," a unique aesthetic cultivated by the people of Edo,now known as Tokyo. Defined by modesty and compassion,it endures to this day.

programme.title: 1/1000: Lay Judges
programme.desc: 1 in 1000 Japanese have experience as a lay judge in court cases. We witness a networking event for former lay judges, where they discuss unique experiences. What does it feel like to judge others?

programme.desc: On the 4th floor of a terminal inside Chubu Centrair International Airport sits a white piano, which passersby love to visit and play from the heart.

programme.title: Core Kyoto
programme.sub-title: Cooking Utensils: Craftwork ensures the future of traditional cuisine
programme.desc: Cooking utensils influence Kyoto cuisine, helping to bring out the inherent flavor of local ingredients. Artisans and chefs believe that upholding the handicrafts sustains the taste of Kyoto.

programme.title: MATSURI: The Heartbeat of Japan
programme.desc: At Hirosaki Neputa Matsuri, enormous floats called neputa are paraded through the streets. They're decorated with vibrant images, and some feature wire-frame 3D figures.

programme.title: Herbal Symphony #4 Winter
programme.desc: In Uda, discover Japan's oldest private medicinal herb garden, where the natural landscape from 300 years ago is preserved in a botanical time capsule, a sanctuary of the local culture and history.
